capabilities: Keep the current line at a fixed screen position while typing
Highlight the current line or sentence and dim unfocused paragraphs
Write in fullscreen focus mode with configurable surrounding lines
Limit line length and restore cursor position when reopening files
Enable Hemingway mode that disables editing previously written text
extras: Makes a single network request to github.com to fetch release notes on install; can be disabled in settings. Donations accepted via GitHub Sponsors or Buy Me a Coffee.
intentEvidence: This plugin started as a fork of the incredible Typewriter Scroll plugin by deathau.
problem: Obsidian's editor shows the whole document with no way to keep the cursor fixed on screen or dim unfocused text while writing.

relations.evidence: This plugin started as a fork of the incredible Typewriter Scroll plugin by deathau.
The sentence highlighting was derived from Focus Active Sentence by artisticat1.
The writing focus was derived from Obsidian Focus Mode by ryanpcmcquen.
The restore cursor position feature was derived from Remember Cursor Position by dy-sh.
The hemingway mode feature was derived from Obsidian Hemingway Mode by jobedom.

summary: Distraction-free writing toolkit that adds typewriter scrolling, current line and sentence highlighting, paragraph dimming, fullscreen focus, and Hemingway mode.
